title: Fair Agents: Balancing Multistakeholder Alignment in Multi-Agent Personalization Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the PopLift metric to assess the over-recommendation of popular items or destinations in user-side recommendations.

Evaluated using Kullback-Leibler or Jensen-Shannon divergence to compare historical and recommended distributions to ensure the proportional representation of protected groups (e.g., gender in job recommendations).
Evaluated using diversity metrics such as the Gini index and normalized entropy to measure item fairness and ensure equitable exposure for diverse stakeholders and providers.
